title: Producer - Web Summit Rio
description:
About us:

How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, “the best tech conference on the planet”? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal.

And we’re just getting started.

We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter.

To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

The role:

We’re looking for a Producer to join our growing Content Team for Web Summit Rio .

You’ll be responsible for curating, shaping, and delivering high-calibre on-stage content. From speaker booking to on-site production, this is a fast-paced, high-impact role where editorial meets execution.


What you will do
  • Industry Research: Track trends, identify leading voices, and stay ahead of emerging startups and technologies across relevant industries.
  • Speaker Booking: Secure high-profile and A-list speakers, especially for our Centre Stage. You’ll lead outreach, negotiations, and coordination with speakers and their teams.
  • Editorial Ownership: Shape the narrative of our stages. Work with speakers to define compelling topics, formats, and titles. Write talk descriptions, moderator briefs, and technical scripts.
  • Live Production: Manage speaker logistics and live rehearsals. Ensure all assets are prepped and stages run smoothly on-site, collaborating with technical and production teams.
  • Platform & Data Management: Maintain accurate records using our internal platforms and tools. Attention to detail and flawless admin are essential to your success.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with speakers, companies, and stakeholders before, during, and after the event.
  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.
Skills and abilities we're looking for
  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.
  • Your admin and data tracking are consistently up-to-date and accurate, supporting seamless internal operations.
Who you are
  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

Benefits and perks:

- Hybrid-working model open to all employees.

- Fully subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.

- Pension contribution up to 6%(Irish based only)

- A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.

- Company laptop, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.

- Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.

- Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.

- Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year

At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, atuando em mais de 760 municípios e levando saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas. Nosso compromisso é contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nosso objetivo é melhorar continuamente o ambiente de trabalho e os serviços entregues, promovendo uma cultura de inovação, diversidade, ética e eficiência, respeitando as peculiaridades de cada local onde atuamos.

title: Junior Operations Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Nestig is a direct-to-consumer brand with a mission to create the most delightful place to shop for children’s spaces. Our brand is synonymous with quality, innovation, and trust, offering customers a seamless shopping experience and exceptional products for their little ones. As one of the fastest-growing consumer brands since 2021, Operations is essential to our culture, and we believe this is a key part of what sets us apart from the competition. We strive to execute streamlined, backend logistics to ensure customers receive their items in a timely and secure way.

Department Overview

As part of Nestig’s Operations team, you will have the opportunity to help provide efficient and complete resolutions for Nestig customers in a practical and detailed manner. You will report to the Operations Lead, Scheduling from the São Paulo office and will be responsible for working closely with all our Operations team, Customer Experience and Product Development teams to ensure customer orders and issues are fulfilled. You will be a driving force in creating exceptional purchase experiences for our customers (we’re talking cribs, kid beds, rugs, wallpaper, and beyond!) through strong analytical and proactive skills and building problem-solving processes that scale.

This full-time position will be based out of our São Paulo office in Pinheiros.


What You’ll Do
  • Plan our international and domestic (USA) shipping schedule;Coordinate with suppliers to set up shipping and delivery in way that works best for our customers and stakeholders;
  • Be in touch with our partner carriers in order to create resolutions for operational incidents and ensure a seamless logistic process;
  • Own the process of solving a customer problem from end-to-end, working closely with our CX team to ensure a speedy resolution to any issues;
  • Follow up on our logistics operation by taking a proactive position to identify problems before customers do;
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize data to guide strategic decisions;
  • Provide analytical insights and reporting to management to keep track of the current experience and improvement over time;
  • Organize all necessary documentation to ensure smooth processes involving our customers and partners;
  • Engage in projects and initiatives to help increase the efficiency of the Operation and improve the Customer Experience;
  • Use your knowledge, skills, and creativity to improve processes and create new opportunities for growth.
What You’ll Need
  • 1+years experience in a similar, analytical role, ideally within an early-stage, growth-oriented company
  • Must be able to work onsite in our São Paulo office three (3) days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday), as well as additionally as needed
  • Proficient English communications skills (B2+), both verbal and written
  • Intermediate Excel skills
  • A passion for all things Operations — you like helping people and problem solving
  • Comfort with the ambiguity of changing priorities, and the flexibility to embrace new ideas within a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to autonomously manage multiple assignments at once, while meeting deadlines and analyzing impact
  • A willingness to roll up your sleeves and wear multiple hats
  • Self-starter with a can-do, team-oriented attitude and ability to stay calm under pressure
  • Legal authorization to work in Brazil (We are available to hire as Freelancer ("PF") or Contractor ("PJ").)
Why You’ll Love Working Here!
  • Total Rewards: dive into our Total Rewards deck to learn more about Nestig’s benefits and perks.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits through Alice for you and your loved ones
  • Twenty-one (21) business days* per calendar year, prorated from your start date, so you can take your well-earned R&R (*What is a business day? A business day is a weekday that the business is open (nongovernmental holiday weekdays). This means that PTO requests will not need to include weekend day(s) and/or governmental holiday(s) that hug a particular day you are requesting off.)
  • Flexible Work From Wherever (WFW) Policy — up to five (5) weeks of remote work per year
  • Monthly wellness, IT, and commuter stipend
  • WFW stipend, so you are able to create a comfortable working environment at home
  • Annual education stipend, because we are always learning
  • Nestig discount, so you can treat you, your family & loved ones!
  • Paid parental leave of sixteen (16) weeks after six (6) months of employment for birthing and non-birthing parents.
What will this interview process look like?
  • We believe that interviews should be a two-way street — an opportunity for us to get to know you, and for you to learn about life at Nestig. To help you feel prepared and confident, we’ve outlined each step of this recruitment process here .

Nestig is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, national origin, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected class. We believe that diversity is more than just good intentions, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Auxiliar de Farmácia
description:
ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS:

  1. Realizar o recebimento dos produtos no Almoxarifado, conferindo os espelhos de entrada e apontando ajustes e correções necessárias antes do armazenamento.
  2. Fracionar e etiquetar produtos conforme critérios padronizados pela instituição e legislação vigente quanto ao controle de validade.
  3. Conferir os espelhos de transferência com os itens físicos, identificando e solucionando divergências junto à liderança.
  4. Manter o armazenamento organizado dos produtos nos setores de Farmácia, seguindo a regra PVPS (primeiro que vence, primeiro que sai).
  5. Apoiar o controle de validade dos produtos, conforme orientação da liderança.
  6. Realizar controle diário de umidade e temperatura do ambiente e refrigeradores.
  7. Atender às solicitações de dispensação e devolução de produtos ao setor e ao paciente.
  8. Conferir, montar, produzir, dispensar e devolver kits.
  9. Atender pedidos de cotas de estoques, subestoques e carros de emergência.
  10. Dispensar os produtos atendidos, registrando em sistema para o cliente interno.
  11. Atender ao cliente interno, via telefone ou pessoalmente na janela dos setores.
  12. Apontar solicitações fora do padrão de consumo ao Assistente de Farmácia ou Farmacêutico para avaliação.
  13. Auxiliar o Farmacêutico no controle e dispensação de produtos não padronizados e de alto custo.
  14. Zelar pelos produtos estocados, evitando perdas e desperdícios.
  15. Solicitar reposição de produtos ao CAF e/ou Almoxarifado conforme rotina.
  16. Apoiar a liderança com informações sobre consumo, giro de estoque, desabastecimento e validade curta.
  17. Executar contagens rotativas e pontuais conforme necessidade.
  18. Participar dos inventários semestrais, seguindo o cronograma da liderança.
  19. Encaminhar notas fiscais e documentos de empréstimo ao Almoxarifado.

REQUISITOS E BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Desejável noções básicas do Pacote Office.
  • Desejável curso de Atendente ou Técnico de Farmácia.
  • Refeição no local, assistência odontológica, convênio com farmácia, vale alimentação, convênio com SESC, assistência médica.

SOBRE A INSTITUIÇÃO:

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) administra 19 entidades sociais, de saúde e educação, formando a Rede Santa Catarina. Com gestão que reinveste o superávit em suas obras, a ACSC promove atendimento humanizado e de qualidade a milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros.

description:
Open position: Senior Software Developer (Backend)

Join us, and let’s create a safer, more connected world together!

About the Opportunity:

Modirum | Gespi is adapting its proven technologies for the dynamic UAV Defence sector through a dedicated new development team. We are seeking experienced Senior Backend Software Developers to design, build, and maintain the scalable, secure, and reliable server-side systems that underpin our innovative defence solutions. You will tackle complex technical challenges and contribute significantly to the core functionality of our products.

Your Role in the Team:

As a Senior Backend Developer, you are a cornerstone of the team responsible for building the engine of our defence applications. You will:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust backend services, APIs, and data persistence layers.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and testable code in languages like Java, Kotlin, Python, or Node.js.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution of the backend systems.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, AI specialists, hardware engineers, and the product team to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Implement security and data protection best practices crucial for the defence sector.
  • Mentor junior developers and participate actively in code reviews, promoting high standards.
  • Troubleshoot and debug complex backend issues, ensuring system stability.
  • Play a key role in the team’s output by delivering high-quality backend features and infrastructure components.

Qualifications:

As a Senior Backend Developer, you are a cornerstone of the team responsible for building the engine of our defence applications. You will:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Software Developer focused on backend systems.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js).
  • Solid experience designing and building RESTful APIs or other service communication protocols (e.g., gRPC).
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Understanding of software design patterns, microservices architecture, and distributed systems concepts.
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience building systems for Defence, Aerospace, or other high-security/high-reliability domains.
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or event-driven architectures.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and optimization techniques.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation tools.
  • Contribution to open-source projects

What We Offer:

  • The opportunity to build critical backend systems for the high-impact UAV Defence sector.
  • A senior technical role within a new team adapting proven technology for a challenging market.
  • Work on complex backend problems related to scale, security, and data processing.
  • Collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of experts.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A culture that values technical depth and collaboration.

Estamos em crescimento: Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, permitindo que o Dakier atue de forma remota e presencial;
Somos Modernos: por meio de um cartão de crédito da bandeira Mastercard, você recebe o vale refeição, dando mais liberdade ao Dakier de como utilizar;
Transporte: realizamos o depósito direto no VT de acordo com a necessidade de passagem do Dakier até a unidade;
Saúde: Hoje disponibilizamos para o nosso Dakier a Assistência Médica e Odontológica, e também o Total Pass;
Mimo: Nossos Dakier tem desconto de 10% em todas as compras feitas em nosso do APP.

Sobre a Daki:
Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.

title: Senior Developer - SAP Concur Cloud Services
description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

Do you want to develop products and services that impact thousands of clients and millions of users around the globe? Are you ready to play a key role in defining and implementing services and solutions that have an impact across our entire company? Do you dream of delivering excellence and driving innovation? If the answer is yes, then the Platform team, Cloud Services at SAP Concur is the place for you

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our team, you will:

  • Solve complex problems and design systems that enable best-in-class operation of SAP Concur’s cloud services and communications with our customers.
  • Develop across the full-stack on a variety of technologies including Python, Lambda, Boto client, SQS, Sceptre, Cloud Custodian, Dynamo, Docker containers, Kubernetes and AWS ECS.
  • Leverage the latest and greatest AWS Cloud technologies as you build and innovate.
  • Embrace end-to-end ownership and DevOps practices: architect, design, code, test, deploy and monitor your software in providing direct value to our customers.
  • Cooperate with and mentor other engineers and product owners in an ever-evolving, agile environment.
  • Learn, as we move fast and are unafraid to venture into the unknown.
  • Be part of a team that owns products, tools and services that help other teams deliver better software and improve our relationship with customers

In order to accomplish this, you will need:

  • A solid understanding and experience with software development principles and practices.
  • A passion for maintaining high-quality, robust and scalable services.
  • Good analytical and design skills – you should be able to think about problems broadly and deeply.
  • Attention to details and strive for excellence in the quality of code you produce.
  • A high degree of intellectual curiosity and a lack of fear for learning something new. You should be open to learning from others and also willing to help mentor and teach

WHO ARE WE?

Concur, a part of SAP, imagines the way the world should work, offering cloud-based services that make it simple to manage travel and expenses. Founded in 1993, Concur services are used by 30,000 clients representing 27 million users in more than 150 countries. Your career at SAP Concur is what you make of it. We are inspired by change and by each other, which is a major contributing factor to how we have retained the innovative culture that has created a market leading team of 4,800 colleagues.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • Software development experience with a solid understanding of the full software stack
  • Strong experience with AWS stack. Lambda, S3, SNS, SQS, IAM
  • Knowledge of container technologies: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Cloud Custodian development experience is a plus
  • Proven experience coding object-oriented and modularized software
  • Experience building scalable, reliable, and high-performing software systems
  • Solid Linux and/or Unix skills
  • Experience with RESTful API design and service operation
  • Must have excellent verbal and communication skill

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves.At SAP,you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.
SAP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. Se você acha que pode se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, por favor informe na sua candidatura.

Missão:
Liderar e coordenar iniciativas estratégicas voltadas ao desenvolvimento socioeconômico de municípios, promovendo a inclusão produtiva, a melhoria da qualidade de vida da população e o fortalecimento das políticas públicas locais.

Por meio da articulação com gestores públicos, organizações da sociedade civil, setor privado e demais atores estratégicos, a pessoa profissional será responsável por garantir a implementação eficaz dos projetos, assegurando sustentabilidade, inovação e impacto positivo nos territórios atendidos.

Além disso, deverá mobilizar recursos, monitorar indicadores de impacto social e contribuir para o fortalecimento institucional do CIEDS, alinhando as ações aos desafios e oportunidades do contexto socioeconômico local.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, coordenar e executar programas e projetos sociais alinhados às políticas públicas e diretrizes institucionais;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com gestores públicos para garantir a implementação eficaz das políticas sociais e a integração dos programas aos planos de governo;
  • Atuar na articulação política com órgãos governamentais, organizações da sociedade civil, setor privado e demais stakeholders, promovendo a incidência política e fortalecendo redes de apoio;

  • Estabelecer e fortalecer parcerias institucionais para potencializar o impacto dos programas;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos técnicos, relatórios de prestação de contas e propostas de projetos;
  • Conduzir diagnósticos territoriais e estudos sobre demandas locais, propondo soluções inovadoras para o desenvolvimento sustentável dos municípios;

title: Plant Manager
description:
Yara Industrial Solutions (YIS) is a global unit within Yara International. Our talented workforce of around 2,000 people in 28 countries and on all continents, capture, transform, and apply nitrogen to create a wide range of industrial products for an even wider range of industries. We continue to grow our knowledge about chemistry to support customers’ own processes and supply chains, making a difference to society every day.

As part of the YIS team, your unique contribution will be valued and acknowledged. We work hard to create an inclusive environment where our people can bring their true selves to work. In YIS you can be confident that your development is on the agenda from day one and that whatever your background you will have the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed.

About the business unit


Cubatão covers the entire operation of four manufacturing plants (CUB1, CUB2 and CUB3) from the handling of the raw material to the dispatch to customers. CUB 1 produces NA (53%,61% and 99%), LDAN, and AN solution 82%, CUB 2 produces Ammonia, NA (53% and 61%), HDAN, AN solution 82%, Sulphuric acid, PhosAcid, and MAP, and CUB3 produces Sulphuric acid, SSP powder and NPKs. The unit stretches across a significant area in Santos, Sao Paolo and is recognized as a responsible employer in the region.

About the Role

As Plant Manager you are passionate about achieving operational excellence and have a genuine interest in helping the company and your employees succeed. You will be responsible for steering the continuous improvement and optimization of all processes in the plant. You will lead a competent team, overseeing the production, maintenance, and safety of the unit to ensure compliance with company objectives, quality systems, and customer expectations.

You are a people-person, with excellent communication and collaboration skills, putting them to good use both inside Yara and with external stakeholders. You care about your assets, your employees, your company and your community. You are innovative and resourceful, and eager to contribute to the prosperity of people and planet.


The position reports to SVP HESQ and Production and is based in the region of Santos, Sao Paolo Brazil.

Responsibilities
• Develop a vision/strategy (road map) for present and future operations.
• Aim for excellence and continuous improvement in the overall site operation.
• Propose, defend, and implement the Business Plan for the coming year, managing the annual budget.
• Prioritize and ensure site adherence to legal regulations and to Yara internal HESQ policies.
• Establish site specific policies and procedures based on the framework set by the Yara Steering System.
• Meet annual volumes and fixed cost targets by ensuring reliable and systematic operations.
• Analyze the need for investments and propose projects in adherence to the Capital Value Process.
• Ensure excellent cooperation within the region on best practices and initiatives; to speed up the implementation and usage of such best practices and to achieve optimal synergies.
• Ensure good relationship with unions and/or employee representatives, creating a good climate for industrial relations, while encouraging a performance culture.
• Promote good social citizenship with external stakeholders such as regulatory bodies, authorities, media, local communities, etc.
• Secure workforce and succession planning, focusing on talents and critical positions; ensuring a proper organizational design.
• Lead and support the development of all direct reports, maximizing competencies and alignment to business demands. Ensuring employees have a clear vision of Yara´s performance culture and values.
• Embody a learning attitude, by remaining curious, and seeking out all relevant sources of information to excel in both technical and people related topics.
• Acknowledge, demonstrate, and encourage a good work/private life balance.

Profile

• University degree, preferably in a natural science or an engineering subject.
• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a complex site management, production management or project management in the (petro)chemical industry.
• Ability to create accountability and to lead by example
• Strong team building, decision-making and people management skills
• Hands-on mentality and good interpersonal skills.
• Willingness to travel when needed.
• Fluent in English and intermediate Portuguese.

We can offer

• Learning and development opportunities.
• Competitive terms and conditions.
• Inclusive company culture and a collaborative working environment.
• International, dynamic working environment in a truly global organization.
• Assurance that your contribution makes a difference.

Additional Information

We believe that creating a diverse and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing, but also the smart thing to do. To deliver on this, Yara has firmly anchored Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) in our business strategy and has more than 400 employees worldwide involved in DEI ambassador networks.

Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. VEM SER ORIGEM!

Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.

title: EDP abre inscrições para programa de Trainee
description:
EDP abre inscrições para programa de Trainee

Inscrições podem ser feitas até 24 de outubro para candidatos de formações diversas

Estão abertas as inscrições para mais uma edição do EDP Trainee Program. Presente em 22 países e em quatro continentes, a EDP busca perfis de todas as áreas de formação para escrever sua história em busca de se tornar uma Empresa 100% verde até 2030.

Ao fim do programa, os trainees selecionados podem integrar o quadro de colaboradores da Companhia. As candidaturas podem ser feitas até 24 de outubro pelo site .

Baseada no mote “Go Ahead ”, a 6ª edição do EDP Trainee Program procura atrair e desenvolver diferentes perfis, assumindo a diversidade como fonte de riqueza e potencializadora da inovação organizacional, onde todos dispõem de espaço para reforçar as suas competências e compartilhar experiências.

Para o processo de seleção, os candidatos podem ser oriundos de diversas áreas de formação e de qualquer parte do mundo. Um dos requisitos para concorrer às oportunidades envolve o domínio da língua inglesa.

Após o processo de seleção, os trainees passarão pela fase de onboarding em fevereiro de 2022, com duração de um mês, e participarão de duas rotações por diferentes áreas de negócio, geografias ou empresas do grupo EDP, totalizando seis meses. Em setembro de 2022, os trainees terão a oportunidade de integrar os quadros da empresa em Portugal ou em outros países onde a EDP atua.

O Grupo EDP está continuamente à procura de perfis diferenciados para integrar suas equipes. Desde o início do ano, já contratou cerca de 900 pessoas, demonstrando seu compromisso com os países onde atua. O programa global de trainees da EDP visa desafiar as pessoas a contribuírem ativamente para o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras que respondam aos desafios do setor energético e da própria EDP.

Foco em liderar a transição energética do setor

No primeiro semestre, a EDP anunciou, em nível global, um novo posicionamento que reflete sua missão de liderar a transição energética. Após apresentar um plano estratégico que antecipa em duas décadas a meta de ser 100% verde, o grupo EDP lançou uma nova narrativa de marca com o lema “ChangingTomorrowNow” – “Mudando hoje o amanhã”, utilizado pela primeira vez em mais de 20 países onde a empresa está presente.

A campanha reforça o compromisso da companhia com a descarbonização do planeta, através de investimentos acelerados em energias renováveis, redes inteligentes e soluções sustentáveis para os clientes, além de apoio contínuo à sociedade.

Com a mensagem “a EDP está usando força do vento, do sol e da água para ser 100% verde até 2030 e apoiar aqueles que estão mudando hoje o amanhã”, a empresa responde à necessidade de uma nova energia para o planeta. Este posicionamento inclui um investimento sem precedentes de 24 bilhões de euros na transição energética nos próximos quatro anos, além de ampliar seu caráter social e inclusivo, reforçando os compromissos ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance ) definidos pela administração da empresa.

Sobre a EDP no Brasil

Presente há mais de 20 anos no país, a EDP é uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico, atuando em toda a cadeia de valor. Com mais de 10 mil colaboradores, a companhia possui negócios em geração, transmissão e soluções em serviços de energia voltados ao mercado B2B, incluindo geração solar, mobilidade elétrica e mercado livre de energia. Em distribuição, atende cerca de 3,5 milhões de clientes em São Paulo e Espírito Santo, além de ser a principal acionista da Celesc, em Santa Catarina. Eleita em 2020 como a empresa mais inovadora do setor elétrico pelo ranking Valor Inovação, do jornal Valor Econômico, e referência em ESG, figura há 15 anos consecutivos no Índice de Sustentabilidade Empresarial (ISE) da B3.

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores
  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade
Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Campinas , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos
Pré-requisitos Essenciais
  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em Campinas;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto
  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo
  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos
  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade
O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Cloud Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join our Specialized Consulting Center (SCC) team in Brazil.
Guidewire exists to deliver the industry platform that P&C insurers rely upon to adapt and succeed in a time of accelerating change — and to ensure that every customer succeeds in the journey. We provide the software, services, and partner ecosystem to enable our customers to run, differentiate, and grow their business.
Guidewire InsurancePlatform is the P&C industry platform that unifies software, services, and partner ecosystems to power our customers’ business. InsurancePlatform provides the standard upon which insurers can engage their customers, optimize their operations, drive smart decisions, and innovate quickly. We are privileged to serve more than 500 P&C insurers in 40 countries. We invest heavily in R&D to build a technology platform that combines three elements—core processing, data and analytics, and digital engagement—to enhance insurers’ ability to engage and empower their customers and employees.
The SCC team supports Guidewire Cloud customers in two ways. First, we engage with customers after deployment to support changes to their production system, including new feature development and defect resolution. Second, we collaborate directly with customer development teams to support Guidewire deliveries through a series of specialized service offerings in critical areas. These offerings focus on performance, new feature enablement, production delivery and more to ensure alignment with Guidewire cloud standards and best practices.

Job Description

The Role:

As a Senior Consultant with the SCC team, you will work as part of our Centers of Excellence to deliver specialized services offerings directly to our customers. These specialized offerings support customer implementation and post-production deliveries to ensure their success.

We are seeking a decisive, skilled technical problem solver who has some leadership and mentoring experience, to join our dynamic, expanding global team of technical consultants at the forefront of Guidewire's cloud transformation.


Excellent communication, logical thinking, and a focus on quality are essential.

If you are excited by the prospect of working in a fast-paced, innovative environment as part of a collaborative local and global team, we encourage you to apply.

Successful Senior Consultants at Guidewire typically are:

Passionate about solving complex technical problems and working with some of the biggest insurance companies across the world

Focused on advocating for and writing good high-quality code that follows industry standard

Mentoring more junior members of the team in standards and how to effectively solve complex problems effectively

Interested in talking to customers and working in a role that values communication and presentation skills highly

Enthusiastic about continual technical improvement

Confident communicators, comfortable in speaking your mind and defending promoting your ideas based on merit

Ability and enthusiasm to learn from others.

What are we looking for?

Fluent business level Portuguese, Spanish and English is essential

Advanced exposure to broad technical skills such asObject- -Orientedprogramming Programming (JAVA or C#), relational databases (data modelling/SQL), web UI (design and development), XML, application architecture

At least 5 years experience working with customer teams to understand business objectives and functional requirements

Experience with Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Unit Testing, etc.

An ability to work independently within a team

Leadership experience within a successful development team

BSc in Computer Science or equivalent from a third level institution

What additional skills would be highly desired?

3+ years of experience with Guidewire InsuranceSuite products (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter & BillingCenter)

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

title: 30/12/2024 - Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor
description:
Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sancionou a lei que estabelece um limite para o reajuste do salário mínimo, restringindo-o a até 2,5% acima da inflação entre 2025 e 2030. A medida integra o pacote de controle de despesas obrigatórias proposto pelo governo federal e aprovado pelo Congresso há cerca de dez dias.

Com a nova regra, o salário mínimo para 2025 deverá ser de R$ 1.518, um acréscimo de R$ 106 em relação ao valor atual de R$ 1.412. O número ainda será oficializado por decreto presidencial, a ser publicado nos próximos dias.

A medida busca alinhar o reajuste do salário mínimo ao novo arcabouço fiscal. Assim, os aumentos anuais serão limitados a uma faixa de 0,6% a 2,5% acima da inflação.

A política de correção do mínimo vigente desde 2023 será mantida, calculando-se o reajuste com base na soma da inflação acumulada pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC) até novembro e o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de dois anos anteriores. No entanto, o teto de 2,5% acima da inflação agora restringe a parcela adicional vinculada ao PIB.

Salário mínimo
A aprovação da lei no final do ano legislativo deverá gerar uma economia de R$ 15,3 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos. De acordo com a Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias, cada real de aumento no salário mínimo eleva os gastos federais em cerca de R$ 392 milhões, sobretudo devido à Previdência Social e a benefícios vinculados ao piso, como o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).


Sob as regras anteriores, o salário mínimo de 2025 seria de aproximadamente R$ 1.528, considerando a inflação acumulada de 4,84% e o crescimento do PIB de 3,2% em 2023. No entanto, com o teto imposto pela nova legislação, o reajuste foi ajustado para R$ 1.518.

O pagamento do novo salário mínimo começará no final de janeiro ou início de fevereiro de 2025, referente ao trabalho realizado no primeiro mês do ano.

G Mining Services is a multidisciplinary company which provides professional services in the mining industry for underground and open pit mining projects in precious, base, or industrial metals. Cost Controller
Summary Of Responsibilities
Reporting to the Project Control Manager and in close coordination with the Project Control Lead, the Cost Controller supports the financial oversight of both local and international mining capital projects. The incumbent is responsible for cost control, change management support, financial reporting and forecasting, ensuring that project execution remains aligned with established objectives and budgetary frameworks. Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with project and functional leads to prepare and maintain cost estimates that support effective budget control.
  • Prepare and deliver regular cost reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly), ensuring accuracy and clarity of key cost performance indicators.
  • Participate in change control processes, assist in evaluating the financial impact of scope changes, and contribute to identifying mitigation measures.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with cross-functional teams (engineering, procurement, construction and management) and provide consistent cost data to support project decision-making.
  • Work closely with project and construction managers to support the resolution of cost-related issues and maintain budget alignment.
  • Monitor cost trends and assist in the validation of invoices, purchase orders and cost allocations to ensure real-time accuracy of project costs.
  • Track project performance against the approved budget, report on variances, and support the implementation of corrective actions when required.
  • Contribute to cost analyses aimed at identifying savings opportunities and improving resource allocation.
  • Support the preparation of risk assessments and financial forecasts to help maintain project stability and adherence to budget.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, engineering, business, project management or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of cost control experience in mining, construction, energy or major infrastructure projects.
  • Proficient in Excel and project control software such as Primavera P6.
  • Knowledge of estimation software considered an asset.
  • Able to communicate in French and/or English.
  • Certifications such as CCP (Certified Cost Professional), CMA, or PMP are considered assets.
Abilities
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage tasks independently.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to clearly present financial information.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary project environment.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Additional Information
  • The position is based at the G Mining Services’ office in Brossard, with the possibility of working in a hybrid mode. Office presence is expected for a minimum of 3 days per week.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Principal Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As Principal Concept Artist you will work with the development teams to create memorable environments along with unique and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in both character and environment design will provide the inspiration which will continue to push the boundaries of what Fornite means to our players.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize many different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of Concept Artists and outsourcing vendors
  • Provide timely & detailed feedback for the concept art team and outsourcing vendors
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product

What we're looking for

  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Lead or Principal Concept Artist role
  • Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • 7 + years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who We Are

Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network – even the ones they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet and enterprise network telemetry data, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues – before they impact end- user experiences.

ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the entire Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, helping customers deploy at scale while also delivering AI-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s leading Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability portfolios.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Scale team at ThousandEyes, you will manage a segment of accounts with high propensity to grow, using a combination of strategic engagements and scalable programs to drive success across the customer lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of SaaS, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to lead both one-to-one and one-to-many customer engagements.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor—driving onboarding success, accelerating platform adoption, and leading proactive motions such as QBRs, monthly check-ins, and health reviews. You’ll also act as the voice of the customer, advocating for their needs internally while setting clear and actionable expectations externally.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to promote long-term success, adoption, and retention.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of customers that require both high-touch and scale engagement methods.
  • Conduct strategic touchpoints including monthly check-ins, QBRs, platform health checks, and de-risking motions.
  • Proactively identify customer risks before they surface; mobilize and project manage internal teams to address issues swiftly and effectively.
  • Drive adoption of key platform features that enhance customer outcomes and improve retention.
  • Ensure customers achieve success with ThousandEyes use cases, validated through business metrics and data insights.
  • Deeply understand each customer’s business, market conditions, technology stack, and key stakeholders to identify expansion opportunities and potential for vendor consolidation.
  • Forecast and track customer sentiment, product utilization, and key health indicators.
  • Partner with Pre-Sales and Adoption Engineering teams to drive collaboration, expansion, and successful renewals.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, collecting product feedback and prioritizing requirements based on risk, urgency, and revenue impact.
  • Set appropriate expectations with customers while coordinating internal resources to deliver high-impact items.
  • Help manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical customer issues.
Qualifications
  • At least 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals in a SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle, including risk identification and mitigation.
  • Proven success managing customer portfolios through both high-touch and scale strategies.
  • Excellent communication, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English, with the confidence and presence to engage executive stakeholders.
  • Must be available and ready to work during core U.S. business hours.
  • Organized, proactive, and highly accountable with strong project management and multitasking skills.
  • Collaborative and cross-functional, with the ability to influence across internal teams.
  • Proficient in CRM tools like Salesforce and data-driven in your approach.
  • Technically curious and able to understand and explain software and cloud technologies.
  • Data-driven with the ability to interpret and act on customer insights and performance metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience in SaaS and cloud-based solutions.

Cisco values the perspectives and skills that emerge from employees with diverse backgrounds. That's why Cisco is expanding the boundaries of discovering top talent by not only focusing on candidates with educational degrees and experience but also placing more emphasis on unlocking potential. We believe that everyone has something to offer and that diverse teams are better equipped to solve problems, innovate, and create a positive impact.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification . Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification. Research shows that people from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy. We urge you not to prematurely exclude yourself and to apply if you're interested in this work.

description:
Join to apply for the Regional Finance Director role at Videojet Technologies

Join to apply for the Regional Finance Director role at Videojet Technologies

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environmentthat inspires you to strive for excellence.

Imagine yourself…
  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environmentthat inspires you to strive for excellence.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

It’s all possible with a role at Videojet, a Veralto company. You have likely purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week—after all, Videojet is a world leader in the product identification market, providing in-line printing, coding and marking products, consumables, and software solutions.
Videojet’s technologies play a critical role in ensuring the safety and authenticity of products sold across the globe in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces.
As part of the Videojet team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the world around you—and along the way, you’ll have opportunities to make your mark on our business and your career with ongoing opportunities to deepen your skillset and pursue your ambitions.
We offer:
  • Flexible working hours
  • Professional onboarding and training options
  • Powerful team looking forward to working with you
  • Career coaching and development opportunities
  • Health benefits

Reporting to the Finance and Chief Financial Officer - Vice President, the Regional Finance Director is responsible for supporting the country business teams in the areas of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analyses, data modelling, and analytics to drive sustained profitable business growth for Videojet Latin America (plus Mexico). The Finance Director, will need to focus on the bigger picture and long-term results, and also ensure day-to-day execution of the right actions on time in a compliant manner with the help of his /her team and will be located in Sao Paulo or CDMX.
In this role, a typical day will look like:
  • Create and own the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts for the Sales & Service Organizations.
  • Improve profitability and balance sheet through monthly analysis of revenue, cost and inventory variances. Use the analyses to lead initiatives for the business to improve Product mix, Pricing, Discounts, AP and AR.
  • Build and lead the team and processes for AR, AP, Invoicing, Credit and Taxation functions.
  • Controllership of existing and new agreements with distributors, strategic partners, vendors, and Global manufacturing plants. Consolidation and reporting of budget for all regions. Analyze spending trends and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
  • Provide advisory and consultative support to the team on all finance-related areas, including accounting policies and other compliance requirements.
  • Work closely with the Videojet Global , Product Quality & Innovation OpCo finance teams. Veralto Latin America to ensure upkeep of the highest financial integrity standards while conducting business. Ensure compliance requirements for all internal and external stakeholders

The essential requirements of the job include:
  • 10+ years of experience in finance-roles, with at least 5 years leading multi-national teams in a Commercial Finance role, working closely with Global and cross functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Experience leading and inspiring teams fostering a collaborative and high performance culture
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint and working knowledge of financial planning systems such as Hyperion
  • Excellent knowledge of forecasting techniques
  • Strong accounting background, especially revenue/expense recognition rule with extensive experience in financial forecasting and modelling
  • Great data visualization and presentation skills to provide recommendations based on insight
  • Demonstrated proficiency in time and project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects across critical yet often fluctuating deadlines – and with sometimes minimal and/or ambiguous input from stakeholders.
  • Up to 25% travel required

Preferred skills:
  • Chartered Certified

Videojet is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources—and building rewarding careers along the way.
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
If you’ve ever wondered what’s within you, there’s no better time to find out.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. Join to apply for the Líder Regional de Talent Acquisition, LatAm role at Edelman

Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
Estamos procurando uma pessoa com forte expertise para atuar como Liderança Regional de Talent Acquisition (TA) para a América Latina, integrando nosso time global de liderança de Recrutamento e Seleção / Talent Acquisition.
Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para desenvolver e implementar a abordagem de TA na região LATAM, em alinhamento com a estratégia global, dentro de uma organização com estrutura matricial internacional.
A posição lidera uma equipe responsável pelos processos de recrutamento em vários países (Argentina, Brasil, Colômbia, México e Peru), com contribuição direta para os objetivos globais de atração e seleção de talentos.
Somos uma agência global de comunicação, responsável por construir, promover e proteger marcas e reputações de vários clientes. Entregamos trabalhos de qualidade, enquanto colaborando com uma rede de profissionais dedicados, em um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e focado em desenvolver o que há de melhor em cada um!
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégia: Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia abrangente de aquisição de talentos para a região LATAM, alinhada ao modelo global de talent acquisition. Essa estratégia deve incluir melhores práticas, inovação, iniciativas de DEI (Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão) e planejamento de força de trabalho.
  • Recrutamento Executivo: Conduzir processos completos de recrutamento de cargos de liderança sênior na região LATAM, com foco em identificar, atrair e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos-chave.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Liderar iniciativas de gestão de mudanças para se adaptar às condições de mercado, novas tecnologias e tendências do setor. Implementar soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a experiência e a eficiência do processo de recrutamento.
  • Transformação: Liderar e apoiar esforços de transformação na área de talent acquisition, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Impulsionar melhorias contínuas em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.
  • Abordagem Baseada em Dados: Utilizar dados e análises para embasar decisões, acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atração de talentos.
  • Engajamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com stakeholders regionais e globais para entender as necessidades de talentos e garantir uma experiência fluida e positiva para candidatos e gestores de contratação.
  • Especialização em Marca Empregadora: Conduzir com sucesso ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para posicionar a organização como empregadora de escolha, mantendo uma imagem forte e consistente em diferentes países.
  • Gestão de Equipe Regional: Liderar e orientar uma equipe geograficamente distribuída, demonstrando sensibilidade às dinâmicas culturais locais. Promover colaboração, oferecer suporte e garantir o cumprimento das metas de recrutamento.

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Talent Acquisition - profissional precisa ter o perfil especialista e não generalista;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes multiculturais e distribuídas geograficamente.

  • Histórico de condução de recrutamento executivo (C-level e diretoria), porém também fará posições de todos os outros níveis.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

No BEES, nosso sonho é um só: fazer nossas pessoas, nossos usuários e nossos parceiros prosperarem!

A AB InBev é a cervejaria líder global e uma das 5 principais empresas de produtos de consumo do mundo. Com mais de 500 marcas no portfólio, somos número um em muitos dos principais mercados de cerveja.

No Brasil, somos responsáveis por marcas como Brahma, Skol, Antarctica e Guaraná e temos muito orgulho em tornar o mundo um lugar com mais razões para brindar!

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Product Manager para atuar no time de Personalização do BEES. Será responsável por desenhar, priorizar e liderar o desenvolvimento de produtos de dados, garantindo que as soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades de negócio, com alto impacto e escalabilidade.

Procuramos alguém que combine visão de produto, forte background técnico, pensamento analítico, capacidade de liderança (formal e informal), além de excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e global.

  • Ser responsável por liderar o squad de dados, organizando, priorizando e garantindo a execução das atividades no backlog.
  • Atuar como dono(a) do produto, construindo e monitorando a visão, estratégia e roadmap, sempre alinhado(a) às necessidades de stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Construir parcerias sólidas com os times de engenharia, dados, ciência de dados, produto, design e negócios, garantindo uma comunicação clara, colaborativa e eficiente.
  • Organizar e conduzir todas as cerimônias ágeis da squad (daily, planning, refinements, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Documentar requisitos, features e funcionalidades, traduzindo modelos e soluções técnicas para uma linguagem acessível tanto para públicos técnicos (engenheiros e cientistas de dados) quanto para o negócio.
  • Conduzir análises de impacto, mensurar valor das entregas e priorizar demandas com base em impacto e esforço.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso, garantindo a evolução constante do produto e dos processos.
  • Entender problemas complexos, conectando diferentes unidades de negócio, geografias e linhas de produto, formulando hipóteses, propondo soluções e orientando o time na geração de insights e desenvolvimento de produtos.
  • Promover um ambiente colaborativo, com boa gestão de tempo, autonomia, senso de dono e foco na resolução de problemas.

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Dados, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório) para atuação em contexto global.
  • Experiência anterior como Product Manager, Data Product Manager ou posições similares.
  • Experiência na gestão de squads ágeis, atuando com backlog, priorização, refinamento e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com domínio de métricas e indicadores de produto.
  • Conhecimento prático em SQL e análise de dados (mandatório).
  • Conhecimentos básicos em Python e/ou PySpark são altamente desejáveis.
  • Entendimento dos fundamentos de data science, capacidade de interpretar modelos, criticar resultados e discutir abordagens junto ao time técnico.
  • Conhecimento sólido em engenharia de dados, pipelines e arquitetura de dados para participar de discussões técnicas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão ágil (DevOps, Jira, Confluence ou similares).
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, didática, empatia, influência e gestão de stakeholders diversos.
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado, com autonomia para definir prioridades e flexível para atuar em ambientes de alta ambiguidade e constante transformação.
  • Experiência em ambientes que adotam cultura DevOps será considerada um diferencial.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Data Analytics Manager para liderar nosso time de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica, guiando e apoiando o time na entrega de soluções analíticas que impactam diretamente a nossa operação global. O que você precisa ter

title: Lead Character Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Lead Character Artist to join our Fortnite Battle Royale team. In this position, you will lead and manage a team of Character Artists working on major initiatives within Fortnite. You will work directly with the art and design departments to help our team create and quickly iterate on exciting, purposeful characters that look amazing. You should have a combination of strong creative/visual aesthetics, excellent design skills, leadership experience, and a clear rendering style in modeling characters. You should be able to demonstrate that you can think outside the box and translate an awesome gameplay experience into an awesome visual experience as well as have experience creating stylized to semi-stylized characters.

In this role, you will

  • Create characters and enemies based on direction from the project Art Director and input from the game design team
  • Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of the Epic quality bar
  • Help Epic push the visual envelope by creating stunning and inspiring characters
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule
  • Partner with other departments such as Character Design or Concept Art team, to ensure the models work within the project workflow

What we're looking for

  • Ability to help mentor and coach a growing team of artists
  • Experience designing slick, detailed, modern, forward-looking 3D character assets
  • Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc. Experience with the Unreal Engine is a plus
  • A strong portfolio that showcases an eye for modern fashion-forward aesthetics that speak to our audience of teens and young adults
  • A mind for technical function and aesthetic pursuit with an ability to balance creativity with function
  • Ability to work within gameplay design restraints (environment scale, character abilities, prototype function, etc.) and translate those restrictions into visuals that enhance the experience
  • Experience creating mechanical designs
  • Strong traditional drawing skills and knowledge of the human anatomy
  • Strong understanding of color theory and how color affects mood & focal points
  • Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .
